endorsements.quote: Importantly, these recommendations will emphasize the need for representativeness across populations—ensuring that datasets, evaluations, and implementations reflect the diversity of real-world users and contexts—to enhance fairness and generalizability.

unlisted_practices: Integrate digital mental health and AI into core clinical training curricula and professional development for clinicians and researchers.
Develop transparent, actionable AI benchmarks and consensus standards for mental health AI through a Delphi process and tools such as MindBench.ai.
Expand structured, train-the-trainer programs for digital navigators with core competencies, fidelity monitoring, and certification.
Adapt AI standards and digital navigator training to culturally and resource-diverse contexts, including low- and middle-income countries.

screen.reason: Editorial presenting a 3-pronged road map and consensus recommendations for education, AI benchmarks/standards, and digital navigators in digital mental health.
